# reselling_rootserver_image (Resource)

An image captured from the system disk of a rootserver (volumes are not included). Servers are installed from it with `image_id`. Billed per GB while it exists. Creation waits until the image is available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_rootserver_image" "golden" {
  server_id  = reselling_rootserver.web.id
  name       = "web-golden"
  generalize = true
  labels     = ["web"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name. Changed in place.
- `server_id` (String) Server to capture.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Changed in place.
- `generalize` (Boolean) Generalize the image (reset machine id, SSH host keys, cloud-init state).
- `labels` (List of String) Up to 10 labels. Changed in place.
- `shared_with_sub_resellers` (Boolean) Offer the image to your sub-resellers (main resellers only).
- `stop_server` (Boolean) Shut the server down for a consistent image and start it again afterwards.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number)
- `os_version_id` (String)
- `size_gb` (Number)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_rootserver_image.golden <image_id>
```
